verdict.rationale: The support docs say llamafile ships GPU acceleration for AMD and for Vulkan. That makes a Vulkan path for AMD GPUs plausible, but nothing explicitly states that AMD users can use Vulkan without installing ROCm. An older community comment from the author says GPU performance needed dev tools installed, which casts doubt on the no-heavy-install part. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Vulkan on AMD GPUs, a statement that no ROCm/SDK install is required, setup or flag details, and hands-on corroboration or benchmarks.
